title: Electronic structure modulation of nickel–iron layered double hydroxide via vanadium doping for enhanced oxygen evolution reaction performance
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,43312-43321
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA03882K, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Fang Xianghong, Zhang Ruikun, Zeng Xiaoyi, Xiang Xianbing, Wu Huabing
V4+/V5+ doping optimizes the Ni/Fe d-band center in NiFe-LDH, weakening OH adsorption for superior OER. This yields a record-low overpotential of 254 mV and Tafel slope of 41.21 mV dec−1, alongside a 40.8% lower Rct and 33% higher ECSA.
